mapper.sql: , grouped_fuel AS ( SELECT f.*, MAX(CASE WHEN f.fill_status='FULL' THEN f.fueled_at END) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id ORDER BY fueled_at,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prior_full FROM active_fuel f ), cumulative_fuel AS ( SELECT g.*, SUM(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id,prior_full) AS interval_liters, SUM(CASE WHEN fill_status='UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id,prior_full) AS unknown_count FROM grouped_fuel g ), intervals AS ( SELECT c.id,c.vehicle_id,c.fueled_at,c.prior_full, p.odometer_km AS previous_odometer_km,c.interval_liters, CASE WHEN c.fill_status='PARTIAL' THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN c.fill_status='UNKNOWN' THEN 'UNKNOWN_FILL' WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 'NO_PREVIOUS' WHEN c.unknown_count>0 THEN 'UNKNOWN_IN_INTERVAL' WHEN c.odometer_km<=p.odometer_km THEN 'ODOMETER_INVALID' ELSE 'VALID' END AS calculation_status, CASE WHEN c.fill_status='FULL' AND c.unknown_count=0 AND c.odometer_km>p.odometer_km THEN ROUND(c.interval_liters * 100 / NULLIF(c.odometer_km-p.odometer_km,0),4) END AS liters_per_100_km FROM cumulative_fuel c LEFT JOIN fuel_record p ON p.vehicle_id=c.vehicle_id AND p.fueled_at=c.prior_full AND p.active_marker=1 )

WITH active_fuel AS ( SELECT f.* FROM fuel_record f WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND fueled_at<#{end} AND active_marker=1 )
SELECT f.id,f.vehicle_id,f.fueled_at,f.liters,f.unit_price,f.amount,f.odometer_km, CASE WHEN f.fill_status='FULL' THEN i.previous_odometer_km END AS previous_odometer_km, i.liters_per_100_km,f.fill_status,f.version,f.voided_at,COALESCE(i.calculation_status,'VOIDED') AS calculation_status, CASE WHEN f.fill_status='FULL' THEN i.prior_full END AS interval_start, CASE WHEN f.fill_status='FULL' AND i.prior_full IS NOT NULL THEN f.fueled_at END AS interval_end, CASE WHEN f.fill_status='FULL' AND i.prior_full IS NOT NULL THEN i.interval_liters END AS interval_liters FROM fuel_record f LEFT JOIN intervals i ON i.id=f.id WHERE f.vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND f.fueled_at>=#{start} AND f.fueled_at<#{end} ORDER BY f.fueled_at DESC,f.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
